verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that ObsessionDB serves an llms.txt file (HTTP 200) and a markdown docs endpoint (docs.md). Several other docs pages also have .md variants (feature-status.md, ingesting-data.md, drivers-and-clients.md), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented documentation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents consume these docs effectively, and evidence of the llms.txt index's completeness or structure beyond its header.
